email.body1:
Geoff, saw HSI push its National Training Solution and new AI features across the EHS platform and emergency care.

When the offering scales like that, there are usually more in-market organizations than your reps can reach before you can hire and ramp, and that gap is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for HSI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Geoff, quick follow-up for HSI.

As the emergency care line scales nationally, the target list grows faster than the team does, and most groups cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number. So the coverage gap surfaces late and the quarter gets tight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings HSI needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Geoff, last bit of proof for HSI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how HSI's reply rate likely compares to other training and safety software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to HSI either way.
